description: Java class defining OpenAPIDefinition for matching OpenAPI specifications in mockserver, including methods for creation, cloning, updating, and equality checks.

classes.name: OpenAPIDefinition
classes.description: Represents an OpenAPI specification with methods for creation, cloning, updating, and equality comparison, extending RequestDefinition.

methods.name: openAPI
methods.description: Static factory methods to create OpenAPIDefinition instances from URL, payload, or both.

methods.name: getSpecUrlOrPayload
methods.description: Returns the OpenAPI specification URL or payload.

methods.name: withSpecUrlOrPayload
methods.description: Sets the spec URL or payload for the OpenAPIDefinition.

methods.name: getOperationId
methods.description: Returns the operationId associated with the OpenAPI.

methods.name: withOperationId
methods.description: Sets the operationId for the OpenAPIDefinition.

methods.name: shallowClone
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the current OpenAPIDefinition.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the current OpenAPIDefinition with non-null, non-blank values from another instance.
